topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: Finding the ring, my grandmother's engagement ring, in that dimly lit corner of the pawn shop, the way it caught the light, even here, was almost like a little joke. A cruel one. It's not that I didn’t know things get lost, sold, moved around, but seeing it there, nestled among the forgotten, made my hands feel peculiarly cold. The clerk seemed oblivious, rattling on about its history, as if he knew more than the stories passed down through my family. I excused myself, stepping outside, needing the fresh air more than I cared to admit. The ring was a piece of her, of us, misplaced in a place where no one should have to find it.
